parse.title: Tyashoi Alchemist
parse.text:
Great Spook Exclusive
Tyashoi Alchemist is only available during The Great Spook, when the Tyashoi Alchemist is present in the  Farm.

Tyashoi Alchemist is an NPC located in front of the Alchemy Shop in the Farm during real-life Halloween. They give the player quests, as long as they have  Combat X (10) and 10 hours of playtime.

Shop

[edit | edit source]
Slot Item Cost Notes Requires speaking to the Alchemist[1]
Great Spook Staff  10 Frozen Spider  Frozen Spiders are obtained by fishing in the  Spider's Den whilst using an  Icy Sinker and  Spooky Bait. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Helmet  1 Wet Pumpkin A  Wet Pumpkin can be obtained by wearing an  Appalled Pumpkin (purchased from the Builder) underwater. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Chestplate  5 Decayed Bat  Decayed Bats can be obtained by killing Bats on a player's  Private Island with a  Wither Bow and  Icy Arrows. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Leggings  5 Poisoned Candy
[More Info Needed]
Great Spook Boots  12 Sweet Flesh  Sweet Flesh can be obtained by killing Zombies using the  Sweet Axe, which can be purchased from the Lumber Merchant. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Belt  2 Rogue Flesh  Rogue Flesh can be obtained by killing a Tier I Revenant Horror when it has 1 second left on its despawn timer. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Cloak  1 Precious  Precious can be obtained by giving Dirt Guy an  InfiniDirt™ Wand. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Necklace  1 Obscure Ending  Obscure Ending can be obtained from Guber by completing the End Race with a Blindness I Potion active all the way. It is recommended to use  Enchanted Redstone Block to extend the potion effect. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Gloves  1 Head of Betrayal  Head of Betrayal can be obtained by talking to Jake with a  Cow Hat equipped while a Cow is in his house. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Sword  5 Dead Seed  Dead Seeds can be obtained by using  Enchanted Bone Meal on a  Dead Bush. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Talisman  5 Fairy Wings  Fairy Wings can be obtained by hitting Fairies with  Enchanted Shears. ✕
Great Spook Ring
  •  1x Great Spook Talisman
  •  2x Free Spider

 Free Spiders can be obtained by using the Scavenged Iron Hammer on the iron bars at the bottom floor of Shaggy's house, made by combining the  Scavenged Golden Hammer and  Scavenged Emerald Hammer at an  Anvil in the  Gold Mine.

[More Info Needed]
Great Spook Artifact
  •  1x Great Spook Ring
  •  2x Bread
  •  1x Onion
  •  1x Lettuce
  •  1x Steak
  •  1x Tasty Cheese
  •  1x French Fries

 Onion and  Lettuce can be purchased from the Builder.

 French Fries are obtained by putting a  Hunter Knife in a  Potato Minion.

[More Info Needed]
Eerie Pet  2 Ephemeral Gratitude  Ephemeral Gratitudes are obtained by accepting a Visitor offer in  The Garden within 1 second of the visitor spawning. ✕
Eerie Treat  10 Sewer Fish  Sewer Fish are obtained by Fishing in the Hub's  Sewer. ✔
Eerie Toy  1 Nightmare Nullifier A  Nightmare Nullifier is obtained by completing Bednom's quest, giving them a  Black Coffee and then talking to them 1 SkyBlock day later. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Reforging Manual  1 The Soup  The Soup is obtained by giving any kind of soup to Pablo. ✕
Boo Stone 10,000 Coins A  Boo Stone can be bought from the Tyashoi Alchemist after obtaining the  Great Spook Reforging Manual for 10,000 Coins. [More Info Needed]
Alchemist Recipe  1 Secret I Potion A  Secret I Potion can be obtained by brewing a Dungeon Secret into an  Awkward Potion while wearing the  Monster Hunter Armor,  Monster Raider Armor, or  Lava Sea Creature Armor sets. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook Potion 20,000 Coins A  Great Spook Potion can be bought for 20,000 Coins after obtaining the  Alchemist Recipe.
Scary Grimoire  1x Shadows indicate riddles illuminating unseen stars A  Shadows indicate riddles illuminating unseen stars can be obtained by talking to Sirius with 7,871,265 Coins in the player's purse. [More Info Needed]
Great Spook I 30,000 Coins A Great Spook I Enchanted Book can be bought for 30,000 Coins after obtaining the  Scary Grimoire.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • During the event time in 2021, the appearance of the Alchemy House was changed to a pumpkin while the Tyashoi Alchemist was next to it.
  • In 2021, Tyashoi Alchemist only allows one profile to access the quests; in 2022, all profiles can access but every quest can be done once per account.
  • Purchasing the Great Spook Artifact is the only non-cosmetic use of the Onion and Lettuce decorations
  • Tyashoi Alchemist is an anagram of He is calamity host, which may or may not be a coincidence.
